# SoloCRM

> Agent-first local CRM for solo operators and small companies. Agents manage sales, presales, delivery, contracts, knowledge, audit logs, and exports through a stable CLI and HTTP API.

## Start Here

- [Agent Entry](AGENTS.md): Critical operating rules, first commands, and API surfaces.
- [README](README.md): User-facing deployment and feature overview.
- [Project Overview](PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md): Architecture, data model, and acceptance criteria.

## Agent Operation

- [Agent Deployment Guide](docs/agent-deployment-guide.md): OpenClaw/Hermes setup, CLI exposure, database policy, and audit workflow.
- [API Examples](docs/agent-api-examples.md): HTTP examples for capabilities, actions, audit, and export.
- [Graph Memory Design](docs/graph-memory-design.md): Fact graph story line, schema, recall contract, and AGE option.
- [SoloCRM Skill](skills/solocrm/SKILL.md): Skill instructions for agents operating the CRM.
- [Skill Usage Reference](skills/solocrm/references/usage.md): Command examples and safety rules.

## Release And Audit

- [Release Readiness Checklist](docs/release-readiness-checklist.md): Verification commands and promotion criteria.
- [Agent-First Redesign](docs/agent-first-redesign.md): Design notes for the sales, presales, and delivery model.
- [OpenClaw Install](OPENCLAW_INSTALL.md): One-command OpenClaw deployment path.

## Code Surfaces

- [CLI](solocrm_cli/solocrm.py): Agent command line entry.
- [Agent Router](backend/app/domains/agent/router.py): `/agent/capabilities` and `/agent/actions`.
- [Business Router](backend/app/domains/business/router.py): engagements, artifacts, summary, export, and audit routes.
- [Business Schemas](backend/app/domains/business/schemas.py): request and response shapes.
- [Business Models](backend/app/domains/business/models.py): PostgreSQL tables for engagements, artifacts, and audit logs.
- [Graph Router](backend/app/domains/graph/router.py): fact graph nodes, edges, facts, rebuild, and recall.
- [Graph Service](backend/app/domains/graph/service.py): graph-gated recall and fact ingestion logic.
